narrative:
The rolling forecast now re-runs every week on CDC actuals instead of being rebuilt in Excel each quarter. The 13-week profit index averages 97 against a plan of 100, with an average of 12% of operating profit at risk across scenario drivers.

The wage settlement is the biggest single exposure at 18% of profit at risk. A two-point softening in consumer demand across John Lewis big-ticket and Waitrose premium ranges would take GBP 31M off management operating profit. Energy is moving the other way: 70% of volume is hedged and the forward curve is flat.

The Scenario & Consolidation Agent recommends lowering the Scotland profit index and widening the wage downside.

signals.title: UK consumer confidence softening on big-ticket
signals.excerpt: Major-purchase intentions down for the third month; grocery volumes resilient while discretionary home and electricals soften.

signals.title: National Living Wage uplift confirmed
signals.excerpt: Statutory pay floor rises above most retailer budget assumptions, adding pressure to Partner pay as the largest single cost line.

signals.excerpt: Daily sales, stock and margin modelled to gold standard and already used by the Waitrose Daily Sales CoWork agent. John Lewis equivalent requires foundational work.
